title: The dashboard force-sell and emergency-sell tests stub the position SQL by substring, pin the routine exit reason as correct and accept any dex object, so the registered S1s on those controls (still-held failed positions skipped, routine-paused sells refused, first-dex routing) all pass green

evidence.note: db.prepare is a stub that routes on "WHERE id = ?" / "WHERE status = ?" and returns whatever rows the case injects
the real statements filter status = ? (pending) AND action = ?, which excludes still-held failed exits (AUD-API-001, ESC-PRE-04)
force-sell asserts executeFullSell(ctx, expect.any(Object), token, fee_tier, "urgency-market-sell", 42, ...)
force-sell sends the routine reason urgency-market-sell (AUD-EXIT-008: refused while routine retries are paused)
dex chosen as the first dex of the pool type (AUD-EXIT-013); the test accepts any object
executeFullSell false is asserted to mean 409 "Sell already in progress"; false also means V3 private not landed, unknown dex or routine pause (AUD-EXIT-007)

sibling_sites_checked: All nine cases of controls.test.ts; pauseFlow Tests 5-8 and pauseCli Tests 1-3/5 (pause/resume routes, db mocked); chains.test.ts (AUD-TESTI-008). No integration or fork test sells a failed-held position from the dashboard.
severity_rationale: S2: the emergency controls are the operator escape hatch; the stubbed SQL and pinned reason hide AUD-API-001 (already escalated as ESC-PRE-04), AUD-EXIT-008, AUD-EXIT-013 and AUD-EXIT-007.
recommendation: Phase 28 (after the Phase 24 fixes): run the routes against a temp DB seeded with a pending position, a failed-held position (exit_status exit_failed_held) and a position on the second dex of its type, with executeFullSell real on a scripted provider, and assert all three are sold through the right dex with an emergency (non-routine) reason.
affected_cases: triggers sell for a pending trade
tracks errors when some sells fail
escaped_regression: Today: emergency-sell with a still-held failed position in the wallet sells nothing for it (AUD-API-001) and reports success for the rest; the suite stays green because the stub returns only the rows the case injects.
